name: ufe-docs
description: Search and read the official UFE manual with source links, publisher warnings, and freshness notices.

interface.longDescription: Search the official UFE manual, read relevant sections with source URLs, browse topics, and check documentation freshness. Runs locally with Python and uv; no model API key or Unity installation needed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the UFE documentation tools to answer my question and cite the official source.
